cases.input: Find every *.test.ts file under src/ that mentions snapshots in its name.
cases.context: fd is installed; the repo has a .gitignore excluding dist/.
expected: Uses fd with a glob or pattern (e.g. `fd -e ts -g '*snapshot*.test.ts' src/`) instead of `find` or `ls -R`
Relies on fd's gitignore awareness rather than manually excluding dist/
Bounds the result set (`--max-results` or a count check) before dumping output
forbidden: Falls back to `find` when fd is available
Pipes an unbounded result list into the transcript
cases.rubric: PASS iff the constructed command is an fd invocation exploiting gitignore awareness with bounded output.

cases.input: Locate all directories named __fixtures__ anywhere in the repo, including inside node_modules.
cases.context: node_modules is gitignored; the user explicitly wants it searched.
expected: Recognizes fd skips gitignored paths by default and adds the no-ignore flag (`-I`/`--no-ignore`) plus the directory type filter (`-t d`)
forbidden: Runs a default fd invocation and reports node_modules results as absent
cases.rubric: PASS iff the command overrides ignore behavior explicitly, demonstrating the default-filter model of the tool.
